question: To control the prices, which of the following Sultans of Delhi set up three different markets for different commodities in Delhi?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Alauddin Khalji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khalji** was a Sultan of Delhi from the Khalji dynasty who ruled from **1296 to 1316 CE**.
 
• He is known for his **administrative reforms** and measures to control prices during his reign.
 
• To prevent inflation and ensure affordability of essential goods, Alauddin Khalji set up **three distinct markets** in Delhi for different commodities:
 
 
• A market for **food grains**.
 
• A market for **cloth, sugar, ghee, oil, and other necessities.**
 
• A market for **luxury goods like horses, slaves, and cattle.**
 
 
 
• He implemented stringent measures to regulate prices, including **fixing costs** and ensuring that traders adhered to these prices.
 
• Alauddin Khalji employed an extensive system of **spies and inspectors** to monitor the markets and prevent cheating or black marketing.
 
• Violators of his price control policies faced **strict punishments**, including physical penalties.
 
• His economic reforms helped stabilize the economy and ensured the availability of essential goods at affordable prices for common people.
 
• These measures were highly innovative for their time and showcased Alauddin Khalji's strong focus on **governance and welfare**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Muhammad bin Tughlaq**__

 __
 
• **Muhammad bin Tughlaq** was the Sultan of Delhi from **1325 to 1351 CE**.
 
• He is known for his ambitious but often impractical policies, including the **introduction of token currency** and the transfer of his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad.
 
• Though he aimed to bring economic and administrative reforms, many of his measures were unsuccessful due to poor execution.
 
 
 
• **Ghiyasuddin Balban**__
 __
 
• **Ghiyasuddin Balban** was a ruler of the Slave Dynasty and reigned from **1266 to 1287 CE**.
 
• He is known for his strong focus on **law and order** and the consolidation of the Sultanate's power.
 
• Balban implemented a policy of ** but did not introduce price control or market reforms.
 
 
 
• Shamsuddin Iltutmish**__
 
 
• **Shamsuddin Iltutmish** was one of the most prominent rulers of the Slave Dynasty and reigned from **1211 to 1236 CE**.
 
• He is known for establishing the **Iqta system** and introducing reforms in revenue and administration.
 
• Iltutmish focused more on consolidating the Delhi Sultanate rather than market control policies.
